newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN JULY GOVT FINANCING 2.73B RAND. [CORRECTED 11:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN JULY GOVT FINANCING 2.73B RAND. [CORRECTED 11:40 GMT]

text.p: South African government financing totalled 2.18 billion rand (corrects from "1.74 billion rand") in July, bringing total financing to 20.68 billion rand so far this year, the Department of Finance said on Tuesday.
It said in a statement that financing of 2.73 billion rand was obtained through the issue of government bonds, while short-term loans decreased by 987.9 million rand.

The department added that that 443 million rand was received in the exchequer account during July from the sale of regional radio stations. (Adds third paragraph detailing proceeds from sale of regional radio stations and corrects table to reflect this)

basis. The discount is written off over the life of the loan and
